comment: Pretend play section seems skeptical of all play, but guided play interventions in preschools have strong trial data.

comment: Cesarean delivery section should address recent population claims regarding neurodevelopmental disorders.
editorial_interpretation: Observational links between cesarean delivery and ADHD/ASD are confounded by indication and family background; sibling designs attenuate to null.
